1. Undo the bolt fixing the 5 th speed selector fork to the main shaft.

Reassembly of new 5 th speed selector fork.

1. Lock the sleeve in the vice, with protective plates fitted;

2. Position the selector fork so that the tapered end is in the same direction as that of the sleeve, resting it against the side of the sleeve with the smaller diameter;

Fit the selector fork manually, exerting the necessary pressure, until it is completely engaged on the sleeve.

When it is fitted, check that the sleeve can rotate freely inside the selector fork.

Calculate the thickness 'S' of the scraper ring for the differential bearing pre-loading using the followign formula: S = P - H + 0.12

0.12 corresponds to the interference for bedding in and the pre-loading of the differential bearings. If the value obtained does not correspond to the thickness of one or more adjustment shims available, fit the shim(s) giving the closest value which is immediately higher.
